name: Getter usage without saving result
description: Flags standalone calls to functions whose names begin with Get if the returned value is unused.
definition: Flags calls to functions whose names begin with `Get` (case-insensitively) whose result is discarded, whether the call stands alone (`GetValue()`) or only feeds a comparison, arithmetic, or logical operator whose own result is then discarded too (e.g. `GetDistance(target) > 0` on its own line, with no assignment, `Return`, or condition around it).
